Comment: Cell 1 is the PCell in NR-Multi-RTT-ProvideAssistanceData [34].
Cell 2 is a neighbour cell in NR-Multi-RTT-ProvideAssistanceData [34].

Parameter: Time offset between serving and neighbour cells

Value: Same as time offset between serving and neighbour cells

Parameter: Number of cells provided in assistance data

NOTE 1:The value is up to the UE capability. The possible UE capability value: (1/4 symbol, 1/2 symbol, CP length, half of slot). When the UE reported value is > 3 us, the time offset between serving and neighbour cells is set to 3 us; when the UE reported value is < 3 us, the time offset between serving and neighbour cells is set to the UE reported value.
